text:
Marta: Quick sync — APAC webinar + benchmark newsletter plan. Idea: a 2-stage nudge matrix that separates ‘high intent’ (trial/API callers/partners) and ‘broad interest’ (newsletter list). Need send windows, subject line tests, and a low-risk ramp for infra quotas. Thoughts? :rocket:

Jared: Sounds good. For APAC we should hit local mornings — 09:00 HKT / 10:00 JST. Also recommend the first nudge be benchmark-forward (results/ROI) and the second be product-forward (how it works).

Sana: Agreed on two creative buckets. I can run subject A/B on stage 1. Proposed test lines: 1) "See real infra cost drops — Redwood benchmark" 2) "How we cut latency at 1/10th the cost" — both short.

Tom: Ops note — SES throttle for marketing pool is currently 60k/day. If stage 2 >40k we need to stagger more or request quota bump. Also watch DKIM/SPF warmup for new subdomain.

Marta: Good call. Proposed ramp:
```
Stage 0: seed 5k (partners + high-intent) — local morning APAC
Stage 1: 25k (staggered over 6 hrs) — core APAC list
Stage 2: remaining opt-ins (up to 60k) staged over 24 hrs with hourly batches
```
Also adding suppression for recent opens > 7d and bounce cleanup. UTM scheme: utm_campaign=apac_benchmark_2026&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter

Sana: For segmentation I’ll create three cohorts: [VIP — trial/active API], [Hot — clicked/engaged last 30d], [Cold — >30d but subscribed]. VIP gets a shorter, more technical headline and an invite to the post-webinar clinic. Hot gets normal benchmark creative. Cold gets lighter CTA + webinar recording promise.

Priya: I’ll own creative variants and the webinar landing page copy. Quick ask — do we want a localized headline for JP/SG? small tweaks or full translations?

Marta: Small localization tweaks only (time, currency, phrasing). No full translation for this pass. Keep CTAs consistent.

Tom: Can ops provision a temporary dedicated sending subdomain for this campaign to protect main marketing reputation? If yes I'll open the request ticket now.

marketing-bot: Campaign created — id=cmp_1732109876_apac_v1, tracking template applied, preview links available.

Jared: Measurement asks: add a lightweight benchmark narrative in the email: 3 bullets (latency improvement, cost/unit, sample customer use-case). Also add a tiny CTA for a benchmark PDF download to capture higher intent.

Sana: I’ll set up subject A/B -> send 5k each within VIP cohort and measure open/ctr after 2 hrs. If one wins by >12% lift we auto-roll to stage 1.

Priya: Creative checklist: 1) hero with 1-line benchmark stat; 2) 3-bullet results; 3) CTA to webinar + PDF gated; 4) footer with regional timing. Will share mocks by EOD.

Marta: Plan owners: Sana (segmentation & A/B), Priya (creative/landing), Tom (sending infra), Jared (measurement & narrative). I’ll coordinate rollout and ops approval. :thumbsup:

Tom: Ticket opened: INF-4398 — request temp send subdomain + SES verification. ETA 24 hrs.

Sana: Note — we should suppress any addresses that got product drip in last 14 days to avoid fatigue.

Priya: Shared mock links: https://mockup.host/rdw/apac-bench-v1 (internal only) — feedback welcome.

Marta: Final reminder — runtime checklist before first send: list suppression, DKIM/SPF verified, tracking params smoke test, and a 50-email sanity send to mobile & desktop clients.

Jared: :eyes: will monitor opens and clicks during the first 6 hrs and ping if anything odd.

Priya: thumbs — will incorporate feedback and push updated mock.

Marta: Thanks team — sync concluded. I’ll post final send playbook here 1 hr before Stage 0. :coffee:
